title: Second moment of the biased query score
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $0<p<1$, and let $T$ be a decision tree on sign inputs with any set of leaf labels, whose queries are restricted to an available coordinate set. Under the product distribution in which each sign is $-1$ with probability $p$, the second moment of the sum of standardized signs over the coordinates queried along the path equals the sum, over all coordinates, of their structural query probabilities under the same one-coordinate distribution.
hypotheses_covered: A finite coordinate set of size n
A decision tree with sign queries and arbitrary leaf labels
